Although no malware was found on the host during a full EPP scan, the network behavior and historical SIEM data indicate a high likelihood of compromise. The exfiltration was mitigated by blocking the destination IP at the firewall and deploying DNS tunneling mitigation via Ansible. No evidence of lateral movement from this host was found.

description: Detects DNS TXT queries with high entropy subdomains directed at domains previously associated with C2 activity.

author: SOC Team

        subdomain_length: > 30
        subdomain_entropy: > 3.8
    condition: selection
fields:

    - entropy_score
level: high
